course_name_original: KMM4692 — Kimya Mühendisliğinde Toplam Kalite Güvencesi
course_name_en: KMM4692 — Total Quality Assurance in Chemical Engineering

learning_outcomes.text: Students will learn the importance of quality and quality assurance standards.
Students will learn the role of statistical techniques in ensuring quality.
Ability to conduct individual and group work.
Ability to self-develop by following advances in science and technology.

syllabus_topics: Introduction to quality, history of quality and types of quality
Quality assurance standards, ISO standard series, selection of appropriate standard
Statistical techniques for quality assurance: Data collection, accuracy, precision, and error values of measurement, graphical and analytical data analysis
Interpretation and analysis of control charts
Control limits and specification limits. Process capability
Other variable control charts: Moving range and moving average, median and range charts
bibliography: Kalite Güvencesi Ders Notları, Hazırlayan C.S. Summers, Quality, Prentice Hall, 2000.
Douglas C. Montgomery, Introduction to Statistical Quality Control, Third Edition, John Wiley & Sons, 1997.
academic_year: vigente en el Bologna Bilgi Sistemi (Yeni)
